Questions 1-2 refer to the following case.

A made-up boy aged six has a fever and a cough for three days.

1) Which test comes first for this boy?

A. Chest film

B. Blood count

C. Throat swab

Part II 2019

Correct answer: B

A blood count is quick and guides the next step in this example.
